name: radiance
description: TypeShade Radiance: a game engine written in TypeShade, made for development by a coding agent.

scripts.prepare: bun --bun tshc sync && bun bin/radiance.ts sync examples/dungeon examples/factory
scripts.typecheck: tshc sync --check && bun bin/radiance.ts sync --check examples/dungeon examples/factory && tshc check test examples && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run check:prose && bun run check:ste && bun run typecheck && bun run test
